user.title: SH Auto Update Manager
user.description:
Set up the Auto Update Manager by Smarter Homes LLC.

This integration discovers all available Home Assistant updates (Z-Wave firmware, ESPHome, HACS, etc.) and installs them one at a time with configurable rules and scheduling.

data.auto_update: Enable auto-update (automatically install updates when discovered)

data_description.auto_update: When enabled, the integration will automatically start installing discovered updates during the maintenance window.
data_description.mains_powered_only: When enabled, only mains-powered devices will be updated. Battery-powered Z-Wave devices may stall during updates if asleep.
data_description.category_filter: Filter updates by category. 'all' includes everything, 'firmware' only includes device firmware updates.

abort.already_configured: SH Auto Update Manager is already configured.

init.title: SH Auto Update Manager Settings
init.description: Configure update behavior, queue rules, and maintenance window.

data.one_at_a_time: Install one at a time (sequential queue)
